avis.titre: Effective and didn't blast the skin
avis.texte: I got this for my daughter who has been dealing with acne, and who had no luck with standard salicylic acid products like pads and washes. This was very effective and I feel much better about giving her these products than benzoyl peroxide which is drying, irritating, and has issues with contaminants or breakdown products.

avis.titre: The most gentle salicylic acid serum
avis.texte: I used this serum nightly for 3 weeks, then began alternating nights with azelaic acid to help with dark spots. The serum was really gentle on my sensitive skin and didn't cause any stinging, which was a huge surprise because most acids do make my face react a little bit. I am still getting breakouts a few times a month but they seem to be clearing faster than before which is an improvement! The only thing I don't love about this serum is the smell‚ÄîI know it's fragrance free (which is great!) but because there isn't any added fragrance, it kind of smells like french fry oil? Not the best lol, but it dissipates fairly quickly.

Super easy to use because it‚Äôs nice and lightweight which my skin and I appreciate. After consistently using everyday, I noticed my skin texture looking more even and smooth. While treating my breakouts, reducing the amount of pimples that appeared, it also definitely reduced my post blemish redness in intensity and time on my skin.
It definitely takes a few weeks but I am starting to see improvement. It is very gentle and non-drying.

I love this product and it will be one of my must-haves in my routine from now on. Although it has a bit of a weird smell, the cleanser helps to reduce that and I would rather it smell weird than have questionable ingredients. My acne was much less frequent and my pores were minimized over time. The balance of my skin also improved, with less oiliness, dry patches and irritation. When I did get acne around my period it resolved many times overnight. I still think retinol and retinoids have their place so pigmentation if there is a pimple that comes up, but overall I love this product and think it worked much better than expected.

"Have been using this in conjunction with the Daily Cleanser. I think it's been making a difference, though I'm not sure which product (cleanser vs. serum) is pulling more weight. The serum has an interesting odor that I'm not a fan of, and the texture of the serum itself isn't my favorite. However, it settles into the skin fairly well and although it feels thicker when applying, it doesn't leave my face feeling sticky/tacky like some other serums have done. I have noticed a noticeable improvement in my cystic acne - breakouts aren't as severe, and the chronic acne spots are getting visibly lighter/less irritated in the past ~6ish weeks I've been using it. I'm excited to continue using it and seeing how the results fare longer term."

avis.titre: Smells like potato but keeps my skin clear
avis.texte: This is a very lightweight gel serum. It has a strong potato scent, so I only used it at night. My acne lesions went away after using for about 1 month. My skin type is dehydrated, oily-combo and I think it didn't strip my skin. It really works on helping reduce the number of whiteheads I had on my forehead. However, I wished it didn't have such a strong wet potato smell.
Feels good, but rapidly becomes slightly tacky on my skin. This isn't much of a problem when other products are layered on top, but I found the feeling to be slightly unpleasant.
A nice gentle serum that's easy to apply and helps with redness, and has visible results
This serum eliminated my acne and helped remove stubborn clogged pores beneath my eyes that I was never able to remove or reduce with other products. I'll continue using this product.
